description: Gazela TO-001 handed to the museum by the Slovenian Armed Forces in 2012; seized from the Yugoslav People's Army by the Slovenian Territorial Defence during the 1991 war of independence and the first aircraft of the Territorial Defence — the predecessor of the Slovenian Armed Forces; licence-built by Soko at Mostar from the Aérospatiale SA 341; the sub-variant is not published; the airframe is often referred to as Gazela TO-001 Velenje
aliases: Gazela; Gazelle; SA341; SA 341; SA-341; TO-001; TO001

description: Retired Slovenian Police helicopter; the Slovene Wikipedia article on the Slovenian Police records a retired AB 212 registered S5-HPB as now being at the Park vojaške zgodovine Pivka; the museum aircraft list simply says Bell 212; the Agusta-Bell licence build is likely but not confirmed so the manufacturer is given as Bell
aliases: AB212; AB 212; Bell 212; Twin Huey; S5-HPB

description: Twenty-five metre XXL exhibit obtained through an exchange between the Military Museum of the Slovenian Armed Forces and the Polish Army Museum; the museum's own text notes that the Yugoslav army had 92 of the type and that one was shot down by Territorial Defence troops during the 1991 Slovenian war; this airframe is the Polish exchange aircraft and not that one; no serial published
